variants.after: A shadowed figure hurries past the lane's mouth - the Archbishop's almoner, keeping his promised silence for now, but leaving you burdened with a whispered debt that will surely be called due before morning.
Somewhere close, heavy boots hit the cobblestones in an organised sweep, directed precisely here by the terrified almoner you allowed to flee; the Watch knows exactly who they are hunting tonight.
Sable shoots you a sideways, wary glance, her eyes lingering on the scuffed knuckles that so recently pushed the snooping almoner to a shattered death upon the lower tiles.

The disgraced tailor's debt coat wraps tightly around your shoulders, its heavy velvet and hidden, silver-threaded pockets concealing the brass-bound ledger perfectly against the chill of the soot-stained breeze.

Rough canvas scrapes at your neck as you shift the stolen tome beneath your porter's livery, grateful that such common, grease-stained attire renders you invisible among the labourers staggering home through the smog.

Stray lamplight catches the braided gold epaulettes of your opera usher's uniform, a garish disguise that hides the bulky ledger but threatens to betray your presence in this miserable, filth-strewn corner of the city.
